subject.title: [Feature]: Integrate password toggle functionality across all platforms to let users see password in clear text

question: Should OpenClaw credential reveal controls always reset to masked-by-default, or may visibility preferences persist locally across sessions?
rationale: The useful UX request changes when secrets are shown in clear text, and the issue's proposed persisted preference needs explicit security/product intent before implementation.

options.title: Ephemeral Reveal Only
options.body: Add per-field reveal controls that default to masked and reset without storing visibility state.

options.title: Persist Local Visibility
options.body: Allow local persistence only after maintainers define the exposure tradeoff, reset behavior, and platform scope.

options.title: Defer Broad Rollout
options.body: Keep the current partial web behavior until a full credential-field inventory and platform owner plan are agreed.

recommendation.title: Ephemeral Reveal Only
recommendation.body: Add per-field reveal controls that default to masked and reset without storing visibility state.

likelyOwner.reason: He already reviewed the issue and has the strongest current routing signal across the affected UI and native credential-entry files.
